items_zone_requires_wardrobe_check.name: items_zone_requires_wardrobe_check
items_zone_requires_wardrobe_check.value: "items"."zone_id" is null or "items"."wardrobe_id" is not null

items_complete_metadata_check.name: items_complete_metadata_check
items_complete_metadata_check.value: "items"."status" = 'draft' or ("items"."wardrobe_id" is not null and "items"."zone_id" is not null and "items"."name" ~ '[^[:space:]]' and "items"."category_id" is not null and "items"."added_on" is not null)

items_watch_dates_check.name: items_watch_dates_check
items_watch_dates_check.value: ("items"."status" = 'watching' and "items"."watch_started_on" is not null and "items"."watch_due_on" is not null and "items"."watch_due_on" >= "items"."watch_started_on") or ("items"."status" <> 'watching' and "items"."watch_started_on" is null and "items"."watch_due_on" is null)
